summary: English and Ukrainian first-party discovery evidenced Ukraine's Public Cadastral Map, StateGeoCadastre, Kyiv Oblast cadastral guidance, and current NSDI service documentation. Bounded anonymous checks did not produce a safe parcel-ID-plus-geometry response. No geometry sample is retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, actual result URLs, direct request outcomes, scope limits, safe field allowlist, and uncertainty are recorded in city-2255-bila-tserkva.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, owner/titleholder lookup, or unsafe-field request occurred. One non-qualifying diagnostic TLS-disabled probe is explicitly recorded and excluded from evidence.
